cards.text: Amos, a man the Lord has been showing visions to, has just told of one where the Lord says He will rise up against the house of Jeroboam (Amos 7:9). Now Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, sends word to Jeroboam king of Israel. And friend, this is NOT a thank-you note.

cards.question: In his message to King Jeroboam, what does Amaziah the priest accuse Amos of?

cards.text: Then Amaziah adds, "The land cannot bear all his words…" Not one guy. Not one town. The WHOLE LAND, friend!

cards.question: According to Amaziah, how did Amos say King Jeroboam will die?
Amaziah also reports that Amos said Israel will surely go into ___, away from their homeland.

cards.text: Then Amaziah turns to Amos himself: "Go away, you seer!" No hello, no how was the trip, just GO.

cards.question: Amaziah tells Amos to flee to the land of ___.

cards.text: Earn your bread there, Amaziah says, do your prophesying there, but never prophesy at Bethel again. Friend, that's not career advice, that's a man holding the door WIDE open.

cards.question: Amaziah says Amos can never prophesy at Bethel again. Why not?

answers.text: It is a city of refuge

cards.text: Now Amos answers Amaziah. And he starts by talking about who he is.

cards.question: Amos tells Amaziah he has always been a prophet.

cards.text: Amos says he wasn't a prophet, and he wasn't a prophet's son either. He was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.

cards.question: Amos says someone took him from following the flock and told him to go prophesy. Who?

cards.text: The LORD told him, "Go, prophesy to My people Israel." Friend, I RELATE: one night I'm in the back of a junk drawer, and in the blink of an eye I've got a gold base and a JOB.
Then Amos turns it all the way around: "Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD." Friend, the man who just got told to leave is about to do the talking.

cards.question: When Amos says to hear the word of the LORD, that word is for King Jeroboam.

cards.text: Amos tells Amaziah, "You say: 'Do not prophesy against Israel; do not preach against the house of Isaac.'" Then comes the LORD's word for Amaziah: his wife will become a prostitute in the city, and his sons and daughters will fall by the sword.

cards.question: The LORD says Amaziah's land will be ___ by a measuring line.
The LORD says Amaziah himself will die on pagan soil.

cards.text: Then the word closes with that line again: "Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland." Amaziah said stop prophesying against Israel, and friend, Amaziah just heard the LORD's word himself.
